12.t: Working with data: Tasmanian devil numbers
q: About how many devils were there in 1995?
Calculate the percentage fall from 1995 to 2015.
The fall slows and numbers level off at about 17 000.
Suggest why devils are more at risk than species found on the mainland.
They are endemic to one island, so there is no other population to recover from; low variation may make them all vulnerable to the same disease.
